title: 2022 CODATA: Wien wavelength displacement law constant is 2.897 771 955... × 10^−3
summary: The 2022 CODATA complete listing, from NIST, marks Wien wavelength displacement law constant as exact: 2.897 771 955...
body: The 2022 CODATA complete listing, from NIST, marks Wien wavelength displacement law constant as exact: 2.897 771 955... × 10^−3 m K. The ellipsis is in the file. No further digits are added here. This is the Wien wavelength-displacement constant in the 2022 listing, marked exact, with the file's ellipsis kept.
